slides.title: Source Strategy (Broad GEOINT)
slides.context: Interoperability, composability, and reliability for OSINT-first operations.

options.label: Open-core with premium failover
options.description: Open by default; selectively enable paid providers when SLOs are missed.

previewBlocks.content:
flowchart TD
  A[Open Core Sources] --> B{SLO met}
  B -- yes --> C[Keep open tier]
  B -- no --> D[Enable premium provider]
  D --> E[Re-score trust]
  E --> C

options.label: C: Hybrid B to A to C
options.description: Backbone first, compiler second, policy and multi-view governance third.

options.label: Weighted trust with hard-fail gates
options.description: Score ranking is allowed only after provenance and freshness hard checks pass.

previewBlocks.code:
TrustScore = weighted(latency, integrity, availability, freshness, coverage, cross_source)

Hard fail conditions
- missing provenance chain
- hash mismatch
- stale beyond threshold
- unknown source identity

previewBlocks.content:
flowchart LR
  I[Ingested record] --> H{Hard fail checks}
  H -- fail --> Q[Quarantine]
  H -- pass --> T[Score plus role]
  T --> R[trigger or context or archive]
